ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, C is a point on the line segment AB, M is the midpoint of the line segment AC, N is the midpoint of the line segment BC. If $AC=x$ cm, and $BC= (10-x)$ cm, then what is the length of $MN$ in cm?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Since $M$ is the midpoint of line segment $AC$ and $N$ is the midpoint of line segment $BC$, \\
it follows that $CM=\frac{1}{2}AC=\frac{1}{2}x$ and $CN=\frac{1}{2}BC=\frac{1}{2}\left(10-x\right)$, \\
therefore, $MN=CM+CN=\boxed{5}$ cm.
